newsitem.title: PAPUA NEW GUINEA: Orogen pays 129.3 mln kina for Gobe stake.
newsitem.headline: Orogen pays 129.3 mln kina for Gobe stake.

text.p: Papua New Guinea resources investor Orogen Minerals Ltd said on Monday it had paid 129.3 million kina (US$93 million) to the Papua New Guinea government for a 20.5 percent stake in the onshore Gobe petroleum project.

Orogen, which is 51 percent owned by the PNG government, said the payment to the Mineral Resources Development Co Pty Ltd consisted of the market value of 110 million kina plus a further 19.3 million kina in project cash calls.
Gobe, operated by Chevron Corp, has proven and probable reserves of 92 million barrels of oil with production due to begin in calendar 1998. --Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
